description: Source code implementing sparse tensor operations for Metal Performance Shaders (MPS) backend in PyTorch, including functions for coalescing sparse tensors and computing output positions.

methods.name: compute_output_positions
methods.description: Calculates output positions for unique tensor elements using Metal shaders.

methods.name: compute_output_positions_parallel
methods.description: Parallel version of compute_output_positions using Kogge-Stone prefix sum.

methods.name: mark_unique_and_count
methods.description: Marks unique indices and counts the number of unique elements in a tensor.

methods.name: _coalesce_sparse_mps
methods.description: Main function to coalesce a sparse tensor on MPS backend, combining indices and values.
